name: Compliments
overview: Scripture warns against flattering speech that leads to ruin and deceit, emphasizing the value of sincere praise and godly character over self-promotion or empty compliments. True favor comes not from flattering tongues but from reverence for the Lord, as a woman who fears God is truly praiseworthy. Additionally, God’s word sustains life more than mere physical needs, reminding believers to seek and speak truth rather than flattering lies. Rebuke given in love is shown to gain more favor than flattery, highlighting the importance of honesty grounded in godly wisdom.
